  <defs>

      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#d0d0d0;stop-opacity:1" />

  <!-- Left Track -->
  <rect x="110" y="120" width="80" height="270" rx="15" fill="url(#metalGrad)" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="6"/>

  <!-- Main Body -->

  <!-- Turret -->

  <!-- Cannon -->
  <rect x="241" y="60" width="30" height="196" fill="#404040" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="236" y="60" width="40" height="30" fill="#303030" stroke="#1a1a1a" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Dodo Emblem -->
  <g transform="translate(256, 256) scale(0.6)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="30" fill="#fff" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>
    <path d="M-15,-5 C-10,-20 10,-20 15,-5 C15,5 10,10 0,10 C-10,10 -15,5 -15,-5 Z" fill="#333"/>
    <path d="M10,0 L25,-10" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="-5" cy="-5" r="3" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Details / Highlights -->
  <rect x="160" y="170" width="30" height="170" rx="5" fill="#e0e0e0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="322" y="170" width="30" height="170" rx="5" fill="#e0e0e0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <rect x="246" y="276" width="20" height="50" rx="2" fill="#d0d0d0"/>
</svg>
